   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      18 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 8 jun 2026 - 21 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Bill_The_Window_Man_, 21 ago 2026, 1/5: "This app is borderline unusable now it get worse every update, the UI becomes worse to use, core features harder to access, whole app is slower."
            2. _C0NN0RAD0_, 21 ago 2026, 1/5: "I used to really love opal but the last few months it’s went really down hill and very buggy, I often find it not locking apps at the end of breaks, certain rules not staying paused or reset despite asking them to be reset or paused for xyz time, the app frequently freezing. I can no longer rely on it to reliably enforce screen time and habits."
            3. _S.ley1'_, 4 ago 2026, 1/5: "The app glitches. Sometimes it blocks outside block moments and then doesn't unblock or the app completely malfunctions."
